name: Journal article
description: An article for a journal: a title page, the abstract and keywords, the text, then appendices, acknowledgements, notes and bibliography, with no limits until a journal's template sets them.

source.name: The order of parts that the journals surveyed agree on
source.notes: Every journal in docs/research/formats-journals.md asks for an abstract and most for keywords; appendices go before the references, and acknowledgements are a section or a note. The journals' own templates are based on this one and bring their limits, their anonymity and their layout.
